quadrantHint: Important: P1/P2 · Urgent: overdue or due today/tomorrow. Edit priority or date to move a task.
timelineEmptyHint: Add a task, or schedule an existing one
habitEmbedInserted: Habit check-in block inserted. You can check in right here.
habitInsertNoEditor: Open a document before inserting the habit check-in block.
habitEmbedMissing: ZhiXing GTD is not enabled, so habits cannot be shown.
habitEmpty: No habits yet. Create your first one.
habitDeleteConfirm: Delete "${name}"? Its check-in history will be lost.
habitScheduleWeeklyHint: Pick one or more weekdays; the interval is counted in weeks.
habitScheduleMonthlyHint: Repeats on the start date's day each month; shorter months use the last day.
habitScheduleYearlyHint: Repeats on the start date's month and day each year.
habitScheduleNoneHint: Not added to today's plan; check in manually whenever you like.
habitAbandonedDesc: It will no longer be scheduled, but its history is kept.
habitAutoCheckIn: Check in automatically after a pomodoro
habitCountInvalid: Target count must be between 1 and 99.
habitDurationInvalid: Target duration must be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
habitGoalHelpCount: Reach the target check-in count to complete the day.
habitGoalHelpDuration: Reach the target duration to complete the day.
habitGoalHelpEither: Either the check-in count or the target duration completes the day.
pomodoroRecordFailed: Failed to write the pomodoro record: ${msg}
pomodoroNoDoc: No document is open; focus time was recorded.
habitDateInvalid: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
noTasks: No unfinished tasks. Create one with - [ ] task text.
addTaskHelp: The item is inserted at the cursor of the current document.
addTaskNoEditor: Open a document before adding a task.
scheduleHelp: Set a date and time; the task will appear at that time in the timeline.
scheduleNoTasks: There are no tasks to schedule.
addTaskFailed: Failed to insert the task. Please try again.
taskEditHelp: Saving updates the task, deadline, quadrant, time block, and reminder together.
deleteTaskConfirm: Delete "${name}"? This removes the task block from your notes.
notUnfinished: This is not an unfinished task.
timeNeedsDate: Please choose a due date before setting a time.
settingShowOnStartupDesc: Open the ZhiXing GTD right dock after the layout is ready.
settingPreviewPopupDesc: Open the ZhiXing GTD right dock once to verify it is registered.
settingClickTaskMenu: Quick toolbar on task text click
settingClickTaskMenuDesc: Clicking task text opens a quick toolbar for the due date, quadrant, value for effort, and reminder. Turn it off if it interferes with editing.
settingReminderDesc: Used when a task has no reminder of its own. Individual tasks can override it from the quick toolbar.
settingEventTimeDesc: A task with only a date is exported as an event at this time (24h, e.g. 09:00).
settingPomodoroFocusDesc: Minutes to focus after clicking 🍅 on a task or habit. Default 25.
settingPomodoroBreakDesc: Minutes of automatic break after focus. Set 0 to skip the break.
settingIncludeOverdueDesc: Overdue tasks are always shown in the dialog; this only affects the exported calendar.
settingAutoUploadDesc: 0 disables it. When cloud upload is configured, the same ICS object is overwritten at this interval. Task changes also trigger an upload after a short delay.
settingCloudDesc: Choose an upload mode. Off makes no network requests and hides the storage fields below.
settingBucketDesc: For example my-bucket. Public read is required for the subscription link to work on the phone.
settingAccessKeyIdDesc: Prefer a RAM user that can only PutObject into this bucket.
settingSecretNameDesc: Create a secret with this name under Settings → Secrets and variables. The plugin never stores the secret in its config.
settingObjectKeyDesc: A stable path such as siyuan/task-secretary.ics. Every upload overwrites the same object, so the subscription link stays unchanged.
settingPublicUrlDesc: Custom domain or CDN URL. Leave empty to use https://<bucket>.<region>.aliyuncs.com/<key>.
settingUploadUrlDesc: Only for Custom PUT. A writable full URL (pre-signed PUT, WebDAV, etc.).
settingSubscriptionUrlDesc: The public URL your phone subscribes to. Leave empty to use the upload URL. Pre-signed URLs expire and are not suitable for subscriptions.
settingUploadHeadersDesc: Only for Custom PUT, e.g. {"Authorization":"Bearer ..."}. Content-Type is always text/calendar.
helpText:
- [ ] Buy milk @2026-10-30 !高
- [ ] Call client @2026-10-30 14:30 !中

Value for effort: !高 / !中 / !低 or !1 / !2 / !3.
Only [ ] and [/] are collected. Right-click a task to set the due date and value without touching the text.
metaHelp: You can also write @YYYY-MM-DD and !高/!中/!低 in the task text to set value for effort.
inboxEmptyHint: Write @GTD in today's daily note to capture something new.
clarifyMultiStepHint: Using the first unfinished child block. Completing the card advances to the next child.
clarifySingleStepHint: Single-step task; you can adjust the next action text.
clarifyLoadFailed: Failed to load the next action: ${msg}
clarifyQ1Desc: Do it now; it is important and time-sensitive.
clarifyQ2Desc: Schedule a time block; this is where long-term value lives.
clarifyQ3Desc: Handle quickly, delegate, or batch it.
clarifyQ4Desc: Park it or drop it; do not let it crowd the important work.
quadrantGtdHint: Planned tasks only. Completing a card advances its next step; the task is archived when every step is done.
timelineTapSlot: Tap a time slot to schedule the selected task.
planHelp: The task becomes a draggable block on the timeline.
planInvalid: Choose a date where the end time is later than the start.
settingInboxDaysDesc: How many recent daily notes to scan for trigger items (@GTD / @知识 / @阅读 / @以后) and untagged tasks. Default 30.
settingInboxTargetsDesc: In addition to recent daily notes, keep collecting trigger items from a specified notebook and document.
settingInboxNotebookDesc: Scan all documents in this notebook for @GTD, @知识, @阅读 and @以后. Leave empty to skip.
settingInboxDocDesc: Scan this document for @GTD, @知识, @阅读 and @以后. Leave empty to skip.
inboxColdFailed: Failed to move to cold storage: ${msg}
inboxHintRead: Looks like something to read later
knowledgeEmptyHint: Write @知识 in a daily note to send something here.
knowledgeNoDocs: This notebook has no documents yet.
coldEmptyHint: Write @阅读 or @以后 in a daily note, or use Cold storage in the inbox.
taskListEmptyHint: Clarify an inbox item to move it here.
taskTimeHelp: The deadline is used for overdue and reminders. If the task already has a time block, the reminder uses the nearer of the block start and the deadline.
taskGtdUnavailable: This task has not been arranged yet. Arrange it from the inbox before setting a quadrant or time block.
taskDeadlineHelp: The deadline is used for overdue and reminders; leave it empty if there is no deadline.
taskPlanToggle: Schedule an execution block on the timeline
taskBlockHelp: The block appears on the timeline. Its end time does not trigger a reminder. Unchecking removes the block.
taskReminderHelp: Reminders use the nearer of the deadline and the block start, and remind again at that time. Choose No reminder to disable them.
settingsCalendarDesc: Default time and scope for exported ICS events.
settingsGeneralDesc: Startup behavior, dock access, and the in-editor quick toolbar.
settingsPomodoroDesc: Focus and break lengths, shared by tasks and habits.
settingsInboxDesc: Daily-note triggers and specified notebook/document scope.
settingTestReminderDesc: Trigger the bottom-right toast and a system notification now to verify reminders.
settingsReminderNote: A reminder fires once, showing the bottom-right toast and a system notification at the selected time. If the advance time has already passed, it fires at the task start or deadline.
screeningHint: Esc to exit · wheel to browse · drag to scrub · click a task for actions
settingScreeningAutoOpenDesc: Desktop only. Opens the full-window timeline screening on the first launch each day; press Esc to exit. You can also open it manually from the timeline.
